entities.name: CDV3 protein
observations: The 236-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed Danio rerio CDV3 homolog Q7T370.
A CDV3 Pfam domain (PF15359) was detected at residues 69–188.
Reviewed CDV3 homolog annotations support cytoplasmic localization; mouse CDV3 also has cytosol and plasma-membrane annotations.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: Primary subcellular-location assignment for the exact-sequence Danio rerio CDV3 homolog Q7T370; mouse and human CDV3 homologs also support cytoplasmic localization.

entities.name: Cytosol
observations: Mouse CDV3 homolog Q4VAA2 carries a cytosol annotation; this supports cytosolic localization but is less direct than the exact-match cytoplasm evidence.
